comment: The coverage ratchet (test-strategy.md §6). floor is the gate the
coverage check enforces on every PR: total statement coverage of
non-excluded Go code must be >= floor. Set to the measured number
on the day the gate landed (69.2% on 2026-09-12); raise it as
Phase 1 tests land; hold at 100. Never lower it in the same PR
that lowers coverage. Exclusions live in coverage-exclusions.txt,
one path prefix per line with a reason, reviewed like ACs.
